name: manual_fc1580
claim: Windows-simulating tests run on a case-insensitive dev filesystem can hide failures that only appear on a case-sensitive CI runner; build candidate file names from the configured spelling (PATHEXT as written), compare case-insensitively, add a test that records the names tried, and reproduce CI locally on a case-sensitive volume before trusting a green run.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19 orama-system#423: two simulated-Windows tests passed on macOS and failed on Linux CI because names were built from a case-folded PATHEXT; the reviewer found the same cause; the failure and fix were reproduced on a case-sensitive volume.

rationale: 2026-10-19 orama-system#423: two simulated-Windows tests passed on macOS and failed on Linux CI because names were built from a case-folded PATHEXT; the reviewer found the same cause; the failure and fix were reproduced on a case-sensitive volume.
